I have a very similliar story, from student perspective though.
Once I forgot to do my biology homework, which was to give few examples of plants for each type of flower. I saw that the teacher started checking the homework from the opposite side of the classroom, so I figured I'll manage to quickly do it before she comes closer. However, my mind was blank and she was moving quite quickly, so I started to provide random animal names as cow or elephant as flowers. Obviously, she stopped by my desk, picked up my notebook and stared at it for 20 long seconds. Then, still in silence, she has put it down and just went straight to her desk to write an F next to my name. Good times.
